description: Header file defining the TextOutput class and related utilities for text output handling in Android, including stream operators, formatting functions, and auxiliary classes like TypeCode and HexDump.

classes.name: TextOutput
classes.description: Abstract class for text output with methods for printing, indentation, and bundle management.

classes.name: TypeCode
classes.description: Class representing a type code with a 32-bit integer value.

classes.name: HexDump
classes.description: Class for creating hex dumps of buffers with configurable formatting options.
